summary: Sibanye Stillwater Limited filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on 8 September 2026, as a routine report of a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16. The filing consists primarily of a cover page and references an exhibit (99.1) described only as a 'market release.' No specific transaction details, financial terms, or corporate actions are provided within the available excerpt, which contains no substantive content beyond standard administrative information. Given the absence of any disclosed special-situation event, such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring, the filing appears to be a routine current report with no special-situations relevance.
